title: Молочная Ферма с АВТоУУправлением в Казахстане
reason: Discusses the implementation and benefits of digital technologies in dairy farming.

tasks.task: Describe the workflow of a digitally advanced dairy farm in Kazakhstan.

subtasks.text: Mention the farm in Almaty region that started using digital technologies in 2013.
Explain the role of operators in monitoring and guiding cows to the milking machine.
Highlight the large scale of the farm and its milk production capacity.
Compare the efficiency of the digital system versus traditional farm management.

tasks.task: Describe the automated systems in use at a dairy farm.

subtasks.text: State the presence of automated water supply, scrapers, and automatic brushes.
Describe the continuous surveillance of cows by a computer system.
Explain the use of collars and motion sensors on cow legs.
Mention the digital system for collecting and analyzing data about each cow.

tasks.task: Discuss the economic benefits of digital technologies in dairy farming.

subtasks.text: Emphasize time, material, and labor savings.
